verdict.rationale: Unleash has a public pricing page (getunleash.io/pricing), but the cited snippets from it only list plan features such as export/import, custom strategies, SSO and a stale-flag dashboard. No snippet shows actual prices or names a cost driver. The evidence confirms a published plan comparison exists but says nothing about how cost scales. Missing for 10: published price figures, explanation of cost drivers (seats, MAUs, events, requests), and independent corroboration of pricing transparency.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing
